adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes `destinationCalendar` from a single object/null to an array across the `CalendarEvent` type (`packages/types/Calendar.d.ts`, `packages/core/builders/CalendarEvent/class.ts`) and updates event construction sites to emit `[]` or `[selectedDestinationCalendar]` (e.g. `apps/web/pages/api/cron/bookingReminder.ts`, `packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts`). The webhook e2e expectation also flips from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (`apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts`). This is a real, diff-grounded backwards-incompatible payload shape change for external webhook consumers, but it’s not provably an internal correctness defect (it appears to be an intentional refactor to support multiple destination calendars).
